title: Encoder · Raw patch bottleneck MAE
purpose: Discover and develop reusable RPB architecture components and encoder tools that operations and application projects can configure, train and compose.
boundary: Own the family definition, supported configuration, portable initialization/preprocessing/training/export/resume surfaces and their scoped evidence, with unimplemented coverage stated explicitly. Cuwacunu and other applications own substantial application training and final docking. Keep architecture, configuration, recipe and trained instance separate; checkpoint scores do not restrict a family to one benchmark shape. Follow the shared encoder component instructions and preserve frozen source and research records. The shared component delivery contract governs reusable learning semantics, application recipe choices, raw versus trusted artifacts and release acceptance. A complete training method and source closure travel with the family.
summary: Delivered reusable fresh configurable v22 RPB components with their complete portable training method, source package and bounded CUDA proof at two configurations. All four portable-training-delivery milestones are complete. Native36 remains the historical balanced leader: 8/9 market conditions and four primary frozen transfer comparisons. V30 retains 9/9 market conditions with transfer pending and causal-eligibility limits. Application training/admission and the separate provider/toolset integration Goals remain distinct.

milestones.title: Select and verify an operation-facing RPB contract
milestones.description: Select a version and trained RPB instance for a declared operation, document native outputs and masks, and verify record, fit-artifact and temporal compatibility. Preserve earlier scoped results and comparison limits; no instance becomes a universal default.
acceptance: Bind the exact checkpoint/content identity, architecture/configuration, trained preprocessing, output selector/layout and normalization, plus training/exposure provenance or explicit unknowns. A family/version label alone does not identify an experimental instance.

Provide source/support and availability metadata under foundations-temporal-integrity. End-of-window encodings may use the full available window but must not be labeled prefix-causal without the corresponding dependency and perturbation evidence.

Conformance tests exercise source hashes, native shapes, masks, non-finite data, changed preprocessing and incompatible consumer/index cases. The proposed starter composition is blocked until this bound provider contract and its engineering checks are available.

Retain original research receipts and failures under their original protocols. A probe follows or-05-readouts-probe-protocol; a provider implementation receipt is not evidence that retrieval, risk prediction or dynamics are useful.

goals.title: Expose Hx16 capabilities as a reusable toolset
goals.description: Develop reusable RPB components with supported configuration and portable fresh initialization, TRAIN preprocessing, training, inference, export, resume and validation surfaces through documented CLI/library APIs. Derive dimensions and parameter counts from actual architecture constraints; distinguish implemented capabilities from gaps. Keep family, configuration, recipe and trained-instance identities separate. Cuwacunu and other applications own substantial training and final docking; common provider interfaces do not imply shared coordinates or application quality. The portable-training-delivery Goal owns the complete trainable-family package; this Goal retains common tool conventions and provider/operation integration, reusing scoped evidence where applicable.

milestones.title: Define the RPB tool surfaces and usage contracts
milestones.description: Map existing version-specific APIs, CLI and adapters plus selected future building blocks into common usage conventions; historical model scores and current commands alone do not establish broad toolset coverage. The component-tool mission and shared encoder instructions govern this surface definition; a checkpoint or application-specific benchmark is an evidence instance.
acceptance: Inventory the agreed loading, encoding, export, validation and workflow surfaces, identifying version ownership, implemented interfaces and remaining gaps without selecting a universal RPB instance or resuming research.

Specify versioned CLI/API inputs and outputs, checkpoint/preprocessing and source identities, native output selection, masks, support/availability, operation-specific compatibility and explicit failure/abstention behavior.

Define bounded examples and completion criteria for common provider records and operation integration, retaining distinct local/contextual/global semantics and actual temporal limits rather than inferring them from dimensions or model names.

Separate family definition, supported geometry/capacity configuration, experimental or training recipe and each trained instance. Inventory portable fresh initialization, TRAIN-only preprocessing fitting, objective/optimizer, training, export and checkpoint/resume APIs or explicit implementation gaps. Derive dimensions/counts and declare actual architectural constraints; a benchmark checkpoint must not impose the only constructible shape.

milestones.title: Expose and verify the agreed RPB building blocks
milestones.description: Deliver the agreed callable RPB surfaces, examples and provider-to-operation integration checks, preserving all original research identities and historical evidence. acceptance: Expose the agreed RPB building blocks through documented Linux CLI and reusable library interfaces in the managed container, using common provider contracts while retaining version-specific model loading, inference and export ownership.

Verify selected standalone tools and a bounded provider-to-operation workflow with native layout, preprocessing, masks, source lineage and temporal meaning; exercise incompatible checkpoints/consumers, malformed inputs and missing-artifact failures or abstentions.

Retain actual engineering receipts and examples with explicit coverage and gaps. Keep checkpoints and restricted data private; research runs, fitting and new utility claims retain separate actual bindings, protocol and permissions.

For the selected trainable family surfaces, verify representative supported alternative geometries, latent widths and capacities through fresh construction, forward execution, a real gradient update, export and checkpoint/resume. Bind preprocessing and recipe identities, retain incompatible-configuration refusals and record missing coverage. These engineering checks establish reusable components, while substantial application training and docking remain application-owned.

milestones.title: Audit RPB component and training-method coverage
milestones.description: Completed the source-bound component/training audit. Selected fresh configurable v22 over v20 with the existing streaming TRAIN fitter and separate typed fixed-AdamW continuation as the first portable delivery surface. Recorded supported constraints, masks/loss/gradients, stochastic and raw artifact contracts, the 73-file selected include/fixture closure and licenses, later protected-parent ancestry, temporal limits and a concrete bounded implementation/proof/export plan. The audit itself performed no numerical execution or checkpoint selection. Runtime/example, proof and packaging were proposed at that snapshot and are now complete in the later milestones.
acceptance: Inventory fresh construction, supported geometry/capacity/output configuration, preprocessing, masks/targets, objective and gradient routing, optimizer/update behavior, stochastic state, export/load and exact-resume claims with source locations and implementation gaps.

Specify family, configuration, complete reference/application recipe and trained-instance identities; distinguish raw model/training state from application-authenticated publication, selection, capture and compatible downstream parents.

Audit existing configurable v20/v22 surfaces, shared streaming TRAIN statistics and typed v22 optimizer state before adding machinery. Map later designs requiring protected trained parents. Preserve native36/V30 achievements and their causal-eligibility limits; distinguish end-of-window encoding from a proven prefix-causal output.

Record a concrete source-bound component engineering plan and bounded synthetic verification scope. Preserve original source, checkpoints, protocols, results and unresolved limitations; do not replay historical scores or start application/heavy research training.

milestones.title: Verify bounded RPB training and portability
milestones.description: Passed bounded actual-CUDA verification at C1/H65/F3/P8/D8/W16 and C3/H129/F9/P8/D32/W32. The API fixture passed 127 assertions and 59 refusal checks; the native workflow passed 189 assertions and 26 refusals. Producer proof used 22 optimizer actions, six successful example fits and no resume refits. Exact rows/masks/loss/gradients/model/AdamW/scaler/counters and inference/embedding reload passed, along with skip, temporal-window, malformed input/configuration/state and immutable-output checks. This is engineering evidence without a quality experiment.
acceptance: Use at least two meaningful supported input/output/capacity configurations with artificial data to exercise fresh construction, preprocessing where applicable, forward execution, actual gradient updates, inference export/reload and the declared interruption/resume behavior.

Check the temporal and dependency contract actually supplied, masks/support, non-finite or missing inputs, incompatible configuration/preprocessing/state and stochastic continuation. Preserve explicit unsupported cases instead of assuming CPB behavior.

Retain source/configuration/runtime/binary and output identities, seeds, actual preprocessing fits and physical updates, exact-resume evidence or its limits, refusal cases and coverage gaps. Reuse unchanged scoped proofs rather than replaying historical experiments.

Perform all builds and bounded numerical checks in the existing managed Linux container using named build/output paths and shared GPU capacity responsibly; do not launch a market study, substantial application training or downstream utility evaluation.
